requirements.general_text: Any one of these: STPM (Arts Stream): Mininimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in any two subjects and a Credit in Additional Math OR Math + one Science/Tech/Engineering subject (SPM/equivalent). STPM (Science Stream): Min. Grade C (GP 2.00) in Mathematics/Additional Mathematics and one Science/ICT subject. STAM: Minimum Grade Jayyid in any two subjects a Credit in Additional Math OR Math + one Science/Tech/Engineering subject (SPM/equivalent). Matriculation/Foundation: Min. CGPA 2.00 and a Credit in Additional Math OR Math + one Science/Tech/Engineering subject (SPM/equivalent). Any Diploma in Science and Technology (Level 4, MQF) with a minimum CGPA of 2.75 and a Credit in Additional Math OR Math + one Science/Tech/Engineering subject (SPM/equivalent). Candidates with a CGPA below 2.75 but more than 2.50 can be admitted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment. Diploma in Computing fields (Level 4, MQF): CGPA Minimum 2.50 (some require Minimum 2.75 or additional assesment). Candidates with a CGPA below 2.50 but more than 2.00 may be admitted subject to a thorough internal evaluation process. Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM) / Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) in Computing fields: Minimum CGPA of 2.50 subjected to HEP Senate / Academic Board’s approval. Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (DLKM) in Computing fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 subjected to HEP Senate / Academic Board’s approval. Other Equivalent Qualifications: Must include Math equivalent to Add. Math (or take reinforcement Math in the first semester). Note: Students must pass reinforcement Mathematics before core courses unless exempted. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT: IELTS - 5.0 TOEFL (PBT) - 500 TOEFL (IBT) - 42 PTE - 47 MUET - BAND 3  Cambridge English - 154
